title: Setup wizard
whoTitle: Who are you to your {{ many }}?
whoText: This is what your {{ many }} see. You can change it later under Settings → Profile.
name: Your name
emailText: Your {{ many }} see a warning until your email is verified, and they can only find you by email once it is. We send a link to
emailSent: Email sent. Open the link in it, then come back here and press the button below.
installTitle: Put the app on this device
installText: The app opens like any other app, and notifications are most reliable from it.
installed: The app is installed on this device.
ios: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Then open {{ app }} from your home screen.
noInstall: Your browser has no install button here. Look for Install app in its menu, or see Settings → Install the app.
thenOpen: Then open the app and sign in with the same account.
thenContinues: The setup continues there with notifications, microphone and camera, text size and your key.
finishApp: Finish, I will continue in the app
noApp: No app: continue in the browser
devText: To record a voice message or take a picture, the app needs your microphone and camera. Allow them now, so the first message is not interrupted. Nothing is recorded.
blocked: Blocked. Allow it in the browser settings (the lock icon at the left of the address).
lookText: Make the app easy to read. This is saved on this device, and you can change it under Settings.
notifyText: The same choices as under Settings → Notifications, for the kind of device you use. Turn them on so you do not miss a message.
soundsText: Choose a sound for each thing that can arrive. You can change them any time under Settings → Notifications.
keyTitle: Lock your files with a key
keyText: The key keeps the files in your safebox private, even from us. Make it now, and write down the 24 words you are shown.
haveMany: You already have {{ many }}. Everything is ready.
addFirst: Add your first {{ one }}: there are only seven seats, so choose the {{ many }} who matter most.
inviteText: Or send your invite link. When they open it and sign in, you get their {{ one }} request.
doneText: Everything is set up in this browser.
saveFailed: Could not save. Try again, or choose "Do it later".
emailSendFailed: Could not send the email. Please try again.
emailNotYet: Not verified yet. Open the link in the email we sent, then try again.
emailCheckFailed: Could not check. Try again in a moment.
